'''Coruscant police sector 417''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] that was identified by the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] as a specific [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] precinct's jurisdiction.<ref name="PoP" />

Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], [[Coruscant police speeder/Legends|police speeders]] assigned to that [[Sector/Legends|sector]] gave chase to [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] when she stole a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] to get away from two [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Robonino/Legends|Robonino]] and [[Chata Hyoki/Legends|Chata Hyoki]]. Later, [[GU-series Guardian police droid/Legends|police droids]] from Sector 417 also responded to the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]] to assist the [[Alderaan Guard/Legends|Alderaan Guard]] who were defending Senator [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] from an attack by the same bounty hunters.<ref name="PoP" />

==Behind the scenes==
Coruscant police sector 417 first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode [[Pursuit of Peace]]. Police Sector 417 was written on the side of the police speeders that appeared in that episode.
